status: inert reference for a reviewed host renderer; not executable remote UI
title: Buyer rewards
summary: Every Nth eligible buy earns a fixed ETH reward while its pre-funded budget lasts.

actions.label: Add reward budget
actions.confirmation: You fund this instance under its fixed rules. Unused funds go to its displayed refund wallet after expiry.

actions.label: Claim ETH
actions.confirmation: ETH is paid to the displayed beneficiary, regardless of who sends the transaction.

actions.label: Claim to another wallet
actions.confirmation: Only your own existing claim is sent to this address.

actions.label: Reclaim unused budget
actions.confirmation: Unused budget becomes your ETH claim. Existing buyer claims remain available.

states.disconnected: Show reads and fixed roles; request wallet connection before transactions.
states.wrong-chain: Keep transaction controls disabled until the released host chain is selected.
states.unverified-binding: Show unavailable; do not build transactions from submitted target addresses.
states.empty-budget: No reward can be earned until this instance receives sufficient funding.
states.expired: No further buys qualify. The fixed refund wallet can reclaim unused budget.
states.wrong-role: Show the required refund wallet and why this account cannot reclaim.
states.pending: Disable duplicate actions, retain decoded transaction details and transaction hash.
states.stale-nonce: Refresh nonce, budget and deadline; require a fresh wallet transaction.
states.reverted: Preserve last confirmed state and display the concrete failure.
states.confirmed: Refresh chain reads before reporting updated balances. Indexer receipt alone is insufficient.

presentation.unknownCapabilities: unavailable until reviewed and implemented by the host
presentation.amounts: Exact decimal strings; display ETH while retaining wei for calls.
presentation.orderingDisclosure: Predictable Nth-buy ordering can be strategically targeted; wallet counts are not proof of distinct people.
